# External waveform fixtures

These captures provide reproducible offline regressions without laboratory
hardware. See [`docs/test-assets.md`](../../../docs/test-assets.md) for source,
license, checksum, channel mapping, decoder options and expected results.

- `uart/`, `i2c/` and `spi/` contain public-domain sigrok-dumps sessions.
- `i3c/i3c_sdr_smoke.csv` and `avsbus/avsbus_smoke.csv` are deterministic
  captures generated by DecodeHub's test encoders.
- Real KingstVIS KVDAT captures are optional local fixtures because their
  forum attachments do not state redistribution terms. Their immutable hashes
  and source URLs are documented, but their bytes are not published here. Set
  `DECODEHUB_KVDAT_FIXTURES` to their directory to enable those tests.

The manifest test verifies that every published waveform remains byte-identical.
